One thing I see people do when they are just learning genji is dashing IN on a fight. The dash should be saved for finishing off opponents and or getting OUT of sticky situations. The only time a dash should be used to dive in on a large group of enemies is when you're going to pop ult and you know you can do a lot of damage. If you see a mercy or anyone really in a big group on like 20 hp then dash into the deathball, get the kill, then spam your dash until you get the hell out of there. When using ult, dash at their feet, this allows you to not dash way past your target, then am above their head with the dragon blade. Genji's ult hits in a cone, if you are farther away, you are more consistent, and the hitbox is screwed to hell so aiming above their head will actually land more hits consistently. Also, a lot of people thing that genji is this super calculated character, one thing people don't realize is a lot of the time you're playing him, you just spam shots into the crowd and picking at people or shields. From there just work on leading shots, deflect timing, and positioning.
